steps.speaker: Calm Female Voice
steps.content: Those creatures are still alive. Don't stop shooting. Keep them under control.

steps.speaker: Male Voice
steps.content: Copy!

steps.speaker: Calm Female Voice
steps.content: Chief—${PlayerName}, can you hear me?

steps.speaker: Calm Female Voice
steps.content: Hold on. I'll get you out soon.

steps.speaker: Male Voice
steps.content: Deputy Chief, watch out!
Over you, the body suddenly jerks. Several monsters burst out from under the ground all of a sudden, separating you and the rescuers.

steps.speaker: Calm Female Voice
steps.content: Not dead yet? Protect Chief! Team Four, cover!

steps.speaker: Calm Female Voice
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, get away from her now!
You struggle to get up, but a hand presses you back into the icy liquid.
The woman who should've been dead props herself up. She slowly approaches with the foul smell of blood, trapping you in a narrow space.

steps.speaker: Intruder
steps.content: Where are you going? It's not over between us yet...

steps.speaker: Intruder
steps.content: I won't give up easily.
The woman brushes your cheek with her hand. Her nails scratch your skin, leaving a sting.

steps.speaker: Intruder
steps.content: Hmm... Heheh...
She presses down on the wound.

steps.speaker: Intruder
steps.content: I can't take you away now, in this case...

steps.speaker: Intruder
steps.content: This body... you can just give it to me.
She licks her finger and slowly gets up.
The terrifying smile on her face gradually blurs, even her body begins to distort and deform—and eventually turns into yours.

steps.speaker: Intruder
steps.content: Goodbye, ${PlayerName}.
She sits on the raised platform and leaves unhurriedly, with your face still on her.
